description: This file defines a testing framework for validation functions within the Kubernetes code generator. It includes a Scheme type for registration and validation, and a ValidationTestBuilder for constructing validation tests, including fixture management and error expectation methods.

classes.name: Scheme
classes.description: A structure for registering validation functions and performing validation on objects, supporting test registration and error handling.

classes.name: ValidationTestBuilder
classes.description: A builder for creating validation tests, managing test fixtures, and fuzzing values.

classes.name: ValidationTester
classes.description: A helper for executing validation tests, checking for expected errors, and validating object states.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new Scheme instance with initialized validation functions map.

methods.name: AddValidationFunc
methods.description: Registers a validation function for a specific type.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates an object using the registered validation function.

methods.name: ValidateUpdate
methods.description: Validates an update to an object using the registered validation function.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Adds setup functions to the scheme, handling registration errors.

methods.name: Test
methods.description: Returns a ValidationTestBuilder for this scheme.

methods.name: ValidateFixtures
methods.description: Runs validation tests against registered types, generating or checking fixture data.

methods.name: ValueFuzzed
methods.description: Populates a value with fuzzed data for testing.

methods.name: Value
methods.description: Returns a ValidationTester for a specific value.

methods.name: OldValue
methods.description: Sets the old value for update validation testing.

methods.name: OldValueFuzzed
methods.description: Fuzzes and sets the old value for update validation testing.

methods.name: ExpectValid
methods.description: Asserts that the value passes validation without errors.

methods.name: ExpectValidateFalseByPath
methods.description: Checks that validation errors match expected false validation errors by field path.

methods.name: ExpectMatches
methods.description: Asserts that actual validation errors match expected errors using a matcher.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs the validation, considering whether it's an update or create operation.
